name: Speaker Display — Air Quality Live Readings
description: Whenever an air quality sensor publishes a reading to MQTT, update the speaker-display screen with live CO₂, PM2.5, temperature, and humidity values. The display refreshes on every incoming message — staff and visitors always see current data.
